# Astronomical 0.2.72
## What's new
**A model memory ceiling you control.** Astronomical now caps how much of your machine's memory models may use at a value you can set, instead of an opaque heuristic.
- Out of the box, the ceiling is the total RAM minus 8 GB (the same gigabyte scale Apple uses to market the machine). This is what most users get with no configuration. - You may set any whole-GB value to dedicate a precise slice of RAM to models. Set it back to the default by removing the setting. - Every memory value you see — the model selector, the daemon status screen, the menu, the CLI, and the configuration file — now uses the same convention, so the numbers match the purchase sticker.
## Compatibility
- Existing configuration remains valid. The new setting is optional, and no migration is required.
## Preserved state
- All your saved models, settings, and prompt cache are preserved.
## Distribution
- Astronomical 0.2.72 is code-signed and notarized by Astronomical. The download is published to the public GitHub release for tag v0.2.72, and its digest is recorded in the release manifest so you can verify what you downloaded.
